project_type: Next.js 14 app router with Prisma ORM and Zustand state management
build_system: pnpm with Next.js build pipeline, Prisma client generation
test_framework: No test framework configured - using build + lint for verification
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm build to ensure no type errors. 2. Run pnpm lint to check for code quality issues.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - can install from npm registry. SQLite database at prisma/dev.db. No test framework installed - verify with build + lint only.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: server components for pages, 'use client' for interactive components, Zustand stores for client state, mock data in src/lib/ for data layer, shadcn/ui components, Tailwind with custom propela brand colors.
key_patterns: Data layer: src/lib/data.ts exports async functions that return from src/lib/mock-data.ts. Types: src/types/<module>.ts. Components: src/components/<module>/. Stores: src/store/<module>-store.ts. Pages: src/app/<route>/page.tsx (server component) that calls data layer. Sidebar: src/components/sidebar.tsx with navItems array. Lucide icons. Badge component for status indicators. cn() utility for conditional classNames.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js app router pages; src/components/ - React components grouped by module; src/components/ui/ - shadcn/ui base components; src/lib/ - utilities, data layer, mock data; src/types/ - TypeScript interfaces; src/store/ - Zustand stores; prisma/ - schema and seed; design-reference/ - UI design mockups
